executiveSummary.headline: Reconcile the Event-Space Story and Establish the Canonical Hotel Domain
executiveSummary.lead: Waterstone has meaningful reach—53.5% consideration and 76.6% scenario presence—but ranks fifth among six Hilton Honors peers. Its active site presents a commercially useful marina, dining, and meetings offer; the immediate quality risk is that trusted sources publish materially different event-space totals while the historically used domain does not reliably lead research to that active offer.
executiveSummary.metricsNote: AI Consideration is the share of comparable monitored answers mentioning the hotel; Scenario Presence is the share of eligible traveler-need scenarios where it appeared; Certified Peer Position compares only the certified six-hotel set. Presence does not equal bookings, revenue, or traveler exposure.

themes.title: Two Verified Meeting Figures Need Hotel Reconciliation
themes.what: Hilton says over 7,500 square feet of flexible meeting space and a ballroom for up to 225; waterstoneboca.com repeatedly states 18,899 square feet, five spaces, and 220-plus guests.
themes.whyItMatters: Do not select a winner. The difference may be indoor versus indoor-plus-outdoor, flexible versus total, or an outdated Hilton record; events leadership must confirm definitions first.

themes.title: Canonical Domain Control Is a High-Priority Investigation
themes.what: waterstoneboca.com identifies itself as the Official Site and its accessibility statement names www.waterstoneboca.com, while the historically used waterstoneresort.com failed, timed out, or served non-hotel content during research.
themes.whyItMatters: Management should confirm ownership, canonical tags, redirects, booking paths, and partner links before changing infrastructure or describing either domain as universally broken.

themes.title: The Active Site Already Carries Commercial Strength
themes.what: The working site presents SeaSpray and Kasumi dining, marina access, rooms, and detailed meeting content, while Hilton supplies a trusted Curio profile.
themes.whyItMatters: After facts and domain control are settled, the agency can align a distinctive waterfront resort story across trusted channels without inventing a new proposition.

priorities.action: Events leadership: reconcile 7,500+ and 18,899 square feet in one week
priorities.desiredOutcome: Defined indoor, outdoor, flexible, and total space

priorities.action: GM and digital agency: confirm canonical domain and redirects in two weeks
Agency and Hilton support: align approved property facts
priorities.desiredOutcome: Consistent marina, dining, and meetings information

executiveSummary.successLooksLike: The hotel has a signed event-space schedule, a documented canonical-domain decision, approved redirect behavior, and consistent active-site and Hilton facts.
executiveSummary.closing: Waterstone’s active digital offer is commercially credible; the fastest quality gain is to remove ambiguity. Define exactly what 7,500-plus and 18,899 square feet each count, then make waterstoneboca.com and every trusted partner path point to the same approved resort story.

actions.headline: Establish One Approved Meeting-Space Source of Truth
actions.priorityWhy: Two trusted guest-facing sources publish materially different meeting-space totals.
actions.whatWeFound: Hilton states over 7,500 square feet of flexible meeting space and ballroom capacity up to 225. The active hotel page repeatedly states 18,899 square feet, five different spaces, and accommodation for 220-plus guests.
actions.whyItMatters: Both claims are verified, but their scopes are not. They may describe indoor versus indoor-plus-outdoor, flexible versus total, or an outdated Hilton record. The hotel—not the audit—must reconcile the definitions before correction.
recommendedSteps: Events leadership defines total indoor, outdoor, flexible, and ballroom space.
Document whether each published number uses a different scope.
Submit precise corrections to Hilton and/or the active site.
actions.supportingParties: Hotel GM; Hilton content support; digital agency
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Confirmation in 1 week; corrections within 30 days
actions.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: A signed space inventory defines every component and reconciles 7,500+ and 18,899 square feet.
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: Field-level correction requests are filed for each source that does not match the signed definitions.
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: Hilton and the active meetings page use approved figures and clearly distinguish indoor, outdoor, total, and ballroom capacities.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid only if both figures are accurate under clearly disclosed definitions and the hotel documents why no correction is needed.

actions.hotelApprovalNotes: Events leadership must define the scope behind both figures; do not choose a winning number from public copy alone.

actions.headline: Resolve Official-Domain and Redirect Consistency
actions.priorityWhy: The active site self-identifies as official, while the historical domain produced inconsistent research outcomes; ownership and routing require confirmation.
actions.whatWeFound: waterstoneboca.com identifies itself as the Official Site and its accessibility statement names www.waterstoneboca.com. The historically used waterstoneresort.com failed, timed out, or served non-hotel content during bounded research.
actions.whyItMatters: A clear canonical-domain decision helps guests, partners, and automated systems identify the hotel’s current official source. Probe failures alone do not establish a universal outage.
recommendedSteps: Confirm ownership and intended role of both domains.
Review DNS, TLS, hosting, redirects, canonical tags, and partner links.
Implement and verify redirects only if approved.
actions.supportingParties: Domain registrar; hosting provider; digital agency; Hilton content support
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Decision within 2 weeks; approved remediation within 30 days
actions.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

completionCriteria.investigationCompleted: A domain-control memo records ownership, intended use, DNS/hosting state, redirect behavior, and canonical choice.
completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: Approved DNS, redirect, canonical-tag, or partner-link tickets are filed with owners and rollback plans.
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: Both domains behave as approved across browser and monitored clients, and official profiles point to the chosen domain.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid if management documents that both domains intentionally serve distinct purposes and no failed guest path remains; rationale is filed.

actions.hotelApprovalNotes: Hotel leadership must approve the canonical domain and any DNS or redirect change.

supportingEvidence.note: Failure, timeout, or non-hotel-content observations; not proof of universal outage.

changesOrInvestigation: Confirm registrant and account control for both domains.
Record DNS, TLS, HTTP, redirect, and canonical behavior.
Audit Hilton and priority links for the intended destination.
Do not retire or redirect a domain without ownership and booking-path review.

evidence.label: Bounded technical probes
evidence.note: Repeated timeout/504/status 0 observations for waterstoneresort.com; not proof of universal outage.

technicalDetails.verificationMethod: Domain-control memo plus multi-environment HTTP/redirect checks and live partner-link audit.
dependencies: Hotel leadership must approve the canonical domain and any DNS or redirect change.
technicalDetails.notes: Treat the failure pattern as a high-priority investigation, not proof that the site is universally down.

actions.headline: Align Waterfront, Dining, and Meetings Facts Across Active Sources
actions.priorityWhy: The active site and Hilton profile are both important sources once domain and event facts are settled.
actions.whatWeFound: waterstoneboca.com presents SeaSpray and Kasumi dining, marina access, rooms, and meetings content; Hilton provides the Curio profile. These are strong commercial building blocks once event definitions and the canonical domain are approved.
actions.whyItMatters: Consistent outlet names, waterfront language, event definitions, and inquiry routes make the resort easier to assess without overstating what content changes will achieve.
recommendedSteps: Create a stable-facts inventory from operations.
Compare active rooms, dining, meetings, and Hilton pages.
Assign owners for volatile hours and offer details.
actions.supportingParties: Food and beverage; events sales; digital agency; Hilton content support
actions.suggestedTimeframe: Audit within 30 days after AVA-WBR-001 and 002 decisions
actions.timeframeNote: Timing is proposed and requires accountable-owner agreement.

completionCriteria.correctionSubmitted: Approved content and partner-profile corrections are filed with source-of-truth references.
completionCriteria.correctionVerifiedLive: Named pages match approved facts and route inquiries to current hotel contacts.
completionCriteria.noChangeRequired: Valid if the completed inventory finds no factual mismatch beyond items handled in AVA-WBR-001 and 002; evidence is retained.

dependencies: Operations and commercial leadership approve outlet, waterfront, and meetings facts before updates.
technicalDetails.notes: No paid research or ADP remeasurement was performed.

methodology.scope: Combines the certified ADP baseline with a bounded review of named public pages and zero-cost technical probes. No paid research, Airtable write, ADP remeasurement, or customer publication was performed.
claimTypeGuide: VERIFIED_ISSUE — a directly observed, source-backed discrepancy.
RECOMMENDED_INVESTIGATION — evidence warrants review but does not prove a defect or cause.
REQUIRES_HOTEL_CONFIRMATION — hotel leadership must establish the source of truth before correction.
OPTIONAL_COMMERCIAL_OPPORTUNITY — proceed only if leadership wants the demand.
responsibilities: Hotel leadership confirms facts, priorities, and public changes.
Digital or brand teams implement only approved corrections and document verification.
Dealality packages measurement context and evidence without implying booking or revenue causation.
methodology.monthlyReviewRelationship: Approved actions may be tracked in a later review. Completing an action does not itself prove a change in AI presence, bookings, or revenue.
